unreleased: Add a pub_menu module (src/modules/pub_menu): a Menu page with the lunch menu by week (previous / next week, today marked, dishes grouped as soups, main courses, desserts and the rest, each with portion, allergen numbers and price), the food menu and the drinks menu (categories with items, several prices per item, sold-out items struck through), a legend of the 14 allergens and the pub's notes; the tab is in the address (?tab=food, ?tab=drink); usable at 320 px. A TodayMenu component shows today's lunch menu for an application's own home page. For administrators (an icon in the header): the lunch menu by date with a week overview, dishes you can reorder, take over from another day (the same day last week with one click) and publish or keep as a draft; the standing menu with categories and items you can add, edit, hide, mark sold out, move between categories, reorder and delete; and the notes under the menus

Add a table_reservations module (src/modules/table_reservations): a Reservations page where anyone, signed in or not, chooses a table or the whole pub, the number of people, a day in a calendar (closed and past days are struck through) and an arrival time from the free ones (with the length of the stay for a table), then leaves name, e-mail, phone, a note and consent - next to the opening hours and their one-off changes; usable at 320 px. The link in the confirmation e-mail opens a page with a Cancel button. For administrators (a calendar icon in the header): a calendar of reservations with the number per day, for each day its hours, reservations with contact details and notes, closing the day or changing its hours (with a list of the reservations in the way, each cancelled with its own message to the guest before the change can be saved again), cancelling a reservation with a message and an e-mail to the guest, the regular opening hours of each weekday and one-off changes of a date, and the tables of the pub
